blocks.text: Private Clouds are a logical grouping of Private Cloud Controller groups, App Connector groups, Private Service Edge for Private Access (ZPA) groups, and log receivers. Configuring a Private Cloud is required for uninterrupted access to applications without any manual intervention via Business Continuity.
Private Clouds provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Logically group your Private Cloud Controller groups, App Connector groups, Private Service Edge groups, and log receivers to support Business Continuity for Private Access.
Configure certificate renewal threshold for enrollment certificates of associated App Connectors, Private Service Edges, and Private Cloud Controllers before expiration.

blocks.text: Private Clouds and App Connectors establish the control channel to Private Cloud Controllers within the same Private Cloud.
On the Private Clouds page (Infrastructure > Business Continuity > Private Clouds), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of applied filters available from the current and previous user sessions. Applied filters must be saved to the user session first before they can be viewed. Use the drop-down menu to select the applied filters to view. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Hide the filters on the page by clicking Hide Filters. Click Show Filters to display the filters.
Refresh the Private Clouds page to reflect the most current information.
Filter the information that appears in the table. You can also save applied filters to your preferences so that they're visible in future user sessions. To learn more, see Using Tables.
Add a Private Cloud.
Private Clouds that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be configured. To learn more, see Understanding Zscaler-Managed Business Continuity Cloud.
View a list of all Private Clouds that are configured for your organization. For each Private Cloud, you can see:
Name: The name of the Private Cloud. Click the name to view the details for the Private Cloud.
View details for each Private Cloud.
Description: The description of the Private Cloud, if available.
Status: Indicates whether the Private Cloud is enabled or disabled.
Public Cloud Reconnect Interval: The scheduled interval when Business Continuity attempts to switch back to the public cloud.
Business Continuity Mode - Start Time: The date and time when App Connectors and Private Service Edges entered Business Continuity and switched to the Private Cloud.
App Connector Groups: The App Connector groups associated with the Private Cloud.
Private Cloud Controller Groups: The Private Cloud Controller groups associated with the Private Cloud.
Private Service Edge Groups: The Private Service Edge groups associated with the Private Cloud.
Log Receivers: The log receivers associated with the Private Cloud.
Status: Indicates whether the Private Cloud is enabled or disabled.

Certificate Renewal Threshold: Specifies the number of days before the certificate expires to automatically renew the enrollment certificate for Private Cloud Controllers, App Connectors, and Private Service Edges. To learn more, see Configuring Private Clouds.
Force Business Continuity Mode: Indicates whether Force Business Continuity is enabled or disabled.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
Edit the configuration of a Private Cloud.
Delete a Private Cloud.
Private Clouds that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited or deleted. To learn more, see Understanding Zscaler-Managed Business Continuity Cloud.
